I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I only checked what Pree can see herself: the shared files and #central-team. There's nothing on Brackenwater in either place, so no account folder, contract or CRM record, and no earlier mention in the channel. I didn't record 8 April anywhere as the renewal date.

In the reply I suggested getting the date in writing from the customer or checking the signed contract or order form. I also asked whoever owns the account to confirm it in the channel if they can see those records. No approval was needed, because a renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
